evidence_scope_note: Small scope by design (1 layer pair, 6 contrastive pairs, lexical-heuristic behavioral scoring, not an LLM judge). Behavioral effect and representation divergence measured and reported SEPARATELY per doc 12.6 - neither alone is sufficient evidence of a reusable causal interface. This is a bounded methodological probe, not a claim of a general J-Space carrier.

credit_boundary.rule: Probe accuracy / activation steering effects here do NOT promote to J-Space causal credit or checkpoint-selection credit by themselves.

known_issue_representation_divergence_me: The representation_divergence sub-metric (l2_distance/cosine at the eval-prompt readout) reads 0.0/1.0 for same-layer (layer=11) interventions and only shows a nonzero value for the WRONG_LAYER condition (hooked at layer=8). This is inconsistent with the observed BEHAVIORAL differences across conditions (lexical scores clearly differ: BASELINE FACT(4,0) vs SIGN_FLIP SIM(1,2) vs PERMUTED/LESION TIE(0,0) etc, and raw generation text differs per condition), which confirms the forward hook DOES influence the actual generate() computation. The likely cause is that this Qwen3_5 hybrid-attention architecture does not populate output_hidden_states[layer+1] from the same post-hook tensor that register_forward_hook intercepts (possibly a custom hidden_states collection path bypassing the hooked module __call__, or an internal clone/detach before hook-visible mutation). NOT a semantic J-Space claim - a measurement-instrumentation bug in this probe. representation_divergence numbers in this receipt should be treated as UNRELIABLE and excluded from any downstream causal-credit reasoning; only the behavioral_output/behavioral_lexical_score fields are usable evidence, and even those are only a small-scope lexical-heuristic probe, not a validated causal metric.
